show.description: At the peak of his fame, world-renowned chef Armaan Kapoor : the “Kitchen King” , suddenly disappears, leaving the culinary world in shock. Years later, a quiet kitchen boy named Mannu works in a struggling restaurant where no one respects him. But behind his humble identity lies extraordinary culinary mastery. As betrayal, family rivalry, and a ruthless cooking challenge threaten everything, a shocking truth begins to unfold, the missing Kitchen King may have been hiding in plain sight.
